notes.title: 0.4295 Update
notes.notes:
Buffs:
Temporal Field: Projectile damage reduction boosted from 30% to 50%.


Nerfs:
Plasma Disc: Damage bonus per bounce reduced by 2 per bounce.


IMPROVEMENTS:
Minor UI enhancements.

Improvements to settings menu. 


Fixed:
Resolved an issue preventing play in AI League with 0 quantum credits.

notes.title: 0.36 - The Arbiter Update
notes.notes:
Hello Droners,

I'm excited to introduce The Arbiter Update—your drone's new, trusted companion on the battlefield! The Arbiter will shadow your drone, closely monitoring every move and ensuring you’re always one step ahead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529984/3d7d3acdf798c2362865b5cfe26e31f9f45e0318.png

What does the Arbiter bring to the table?

Enhanced utility: Certain utility & codex effects will now be managed by your Arbiter, adding a better visual effect to the  gameplay.
Future readiness: The Arbiter sets the stage for upcoming account flair options, so stay tuned!

Wishing you thrilling battles and happy gaming!
